in_sanskrit.name: जोगेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the mind or the one who nourishes the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जोग (Joga) - to move or to nourish + ईश (Ish) - Lord or God

in_hindi.name: जोगेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: जोग (Joga) - movement or nourishment of the mind + ईश (Ish) - God or Lord

in_tamil.name: யோஜேஷ
in_tamil.meaning: அல்லது ஜன்மத்தின் அழிவியல் கைகள் (Allathu Janmattin Azhiviyal Kaikal)
in_tamil.long_meaning: யோஜ் (Yogam) - union or connection + இஷ் (Isham) - God or Lord

in_telugu.name: జోగేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జోగ (Joga) - union or connection + ఏశ్ (Esham) - God or Lord

in_marathi.name: Jogesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jogesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jogesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jagat' which means 'world' and 'Ish' which means 'lord'. The name Jogesh signifies the one who is the lord of the earth.

in_bengali.name: Jogesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jogesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Jogesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jagat' which means 'world' and 'Ish' which means 'lord'. The name Jogesh signifies the one who is the lord of the earth.
